nom: TULA Instant De-Puff Eye Renewal Serum

segments.sensitive: Reports from reviewers with sensitive skin split dramatically: two describe severe reactions, including one who developed an allergic-type burn along with worse dryness and swelling and another whose skin burned badly enough to peel; two other reviewers with sensitive skin or sensitive eyes report zero irritation, with one seeing her dark circles lighten within a week.
segments.dry: The one reviewer who names dry skin reports the opposite of relief: an allergic reaction with burning, swollen eyes, and eyelids that stayed just as dry as before, worse than when she started.

concerns.aging: A few reviewers report visibly fewer fine lines or crow's feet, in one case within hours though the effect faded; another reviewer disagrees, saying she saw no improvement in the wrinkle area even though the same use left her skin around the eyes well moisturized.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe the eye area as hydrated, dewy, or moisturized after use, with several specifically noting it's not oily or heavy; two disagree, one saying her already-dry eyelids never felt less dry and got worse with burning, the other reporting it actually dried her skin out after several weeks of a product line she'd had no issues with before.
concerns.redness: Reports diverge sharply: a cluster of reviewers, including some with sensitive skin, describe burning, itching, or an allergic-type reaction, in one case severe enough to burn off the top layer of skin; far more reviewers report the opposite, describing only a pleasant cooling sensation with no irritation at all, including reviewers who specifically have sensitive skin or eyes.
concerns.spots: Many reviewers report their dark circles visibly lighten, in some cases within 24 hours or after being refrigerated; several disagree, including one who used the full product over eight weeks and saw no change to her dark circles at all.

aspects.libelle: Pump jams, breaks, or shoots product
Expensive for the amount you get
Leaves an unwanted shimmer for some

extraits.texte: I'm not one to give terrible reviews but I hate this product so much. I have dry skin, my eye lids were getting very dry since it is getting colder, and I wanted to try a new eye cream. I was originally using cerave but I ran out and wanted to give it a try since it had great reviews. Ran over to my local ulta and bought it. Instantly, after application, my under eyes and eye lids had a burning sensation. Didn't know if it was normal but I continued to use it throughout the week. My eyelids never felt any less dry than they were originally, and if anything, they were getting irritated. I've been waking up every morning with swollen eyes and now I have a burn irritation on my under eyes. I stopped using it a week ago but the product just made my eyes so much worse and have yet to feel and look better. I have sensitive skin, so I wouldn't recommend if you have sensitive skin. I also am unsure if I can return it because I thought I was going to love it so I threw out the box and the receipt. If I can be refunded that would be incredible. It is not a cheap product.

extraits.titre: It burned the first layer of my skin
extraits.texte: I got this two weeks ago to test out the product since I was told it's for all skin types. I do not have sensitive skin and a few days ago the product started to burn a bit, I left it alone thinking it was normal till yesterday night where it burned the first layer skin off under my eye. It is incredibly itchy and has a burning sensation. I as well had bought the mini set for my significant other and they do have sensitive skin but it as well ended up burning their skin

I have sensitive skin and have to be careful about the products I try, saw the reviews about stinging and burning, but I did not experience any of that. However, it did not depuff instantly, there is a minor improvement of puffiness after a couple hours. There are other offerings at Ulta that are more effective at a lower price point.

I have very sensitive eyes and i started using this product for a about a week now. i definitely feel like my under eyes are not as dark. i've been using nightly... not sure if i would purchase again for the price but would consider if i couldn't find a dupe. the applicator with push button is very convenient for making the product go a long way.

Thought I would try this to calm down the under-eye puffiness and make my dark circles diminish. They are my only skin problem at 64, and I will try anything to make these circles go away. I tried it for the entire product, about 8 weeks, every day. Nope. Did nothing. Complete waste of money.
Seemed to be fine at first until I used it for several wks. Started drying the skin under my eyes. Have not had this happen with any other Tula product.
Can't say there's much improvement in the wrinkle area, however skin around the eye is definitely moisturized, and it works like a charm at reducing puffiness around the eye, including eyelids.
